verdict.rationale: Tempo docs say you can link tracing data with logs and metrics. Supporting docs add Prometheus exemplars that jump from metrics to traces, metrics-to-logs switching with preserved label filters, and a knowledge graph that connects metrics, logs, and traces in one workflow, which together cover end-to-end request debugging. missing for 10: detailed docs on the span-level jump to logs and metrics (setup, trace-to-logs/metrics configuration), independent or hands-on corroboration of the workflow.
